prerequisites: The exact watch fixture must expose at least two related cards and a stable video ID.

prerequisites: Explicit account authorization requires an exact disposable accountId plus watch.base video/channel target; runtime and contract derive accountId from DELEGATED_SESSION_ID or DATASYNC_ID and require exact equality with the observed signed-in account.
The runtime supplies the exact blocklist presence/value snapshot captured before dependency writes; setup rejects a target already present in that true original baseline.
The forced empty dependency blocklist is used only as the active test and same-document cleanup baseline.
Cleanup runs before navigation and fails closed unless the same account/video native rating, dependency blocklist, card href, and visible state are restored.

After full harness restoration and route re-entry, an independent fresh-document assertion rebinds the exact approved account/video, proves the native dislike equals its original state, compares exact blocklist presence/value with the true pre-dependency snapshot including nonempty baselines, and verifies any matching rendered baseline card remains visible.
